name: Turtle System 1 loser-filtered breakout
note: A 20-bar Donchian breakout that is only taken when the PREVIOUS breakout, phantom-traded whether or not it was taken, would have LOST -- entry at the broken level, 2N stop, 10-bar trailing exit, stop wins a tie. The 55-bar failsafe overrides the filter. State is the outcome of the most recent breakout that has actually RESOLVED by the current bar, so the memory is causal. use_filter=0 is the unfiltered Donchian control, which is the point of sweeping it.
source: Original Turtle Trading rules as published by Richard Dennis's students (Curtis Faith, 'The Original Turtle Trading Rules'), rules summary at https://www.theturtletrader.com/turtle-trading-rules/ -- System 1 20-day entry with the skip-if-previous-breakout-was-a-winner filter, the 55-day failsafe, N as the 20-day Wilder average of true range, 2N stop, 10-day exit.
